taipei: Landed in Taipei after a 7 hour flight to Seattle, followed by a 12 hour flight to Taiwan. Spend the first 4 days jet-lagged AF but was a fun time and the food was great!
jiufen: Spent the night in Jiufen! Inspired the Studio Ghibli movie Sprited Away. Lots and lots of lanterns...
sun-moon-lake: A day trip to Sun Moon Lake. Biked around the lake, got street food and then watched the sunset on kayak
intro:
First trip to Taiwan! Spent a full month! First 2 weeks were travel and exploring this beautiful island and eating lots of delicious food. Last 2 weeks, remote work; 4pm - 1am 
(-﹏-)
mianyue-line: About ten miles and six hours along the old Mianyue railway line, and a little dangerous in places. The highlight of the trip for me. (Don't forget to apply permit) A 10/10 hike, would recommend
tamsui: We took the MRT from Taipei to Tamsui. Tamsui is a cute town by the water with lots of souvenir shops. We went biking all the way to the Danjiang Bridge to watch the sunset
shifen: Stopped by Shifen on our way to Jiufen. Lots of tourist and lanterns being lit. Did a short walk to a waterfall
shuinandong: Left Jiufen and took a bus to Shuinandong just for a short visit. Very convenient bus to get there and come back. Got food at a cute coffee shop.
